description: Canonical closed support matrix for the RFC 9420 sender classes and Proposal types a v1 durable ak.mls.proposal Event may carry on a Realm or Circle effective scope. It is the machine-readable form of zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 5.2.1 and the single source consumers use to separate a structural payload violation from a producer class this profile does not support.
registry_rules: A durable ak.mls.proposal on a Realm or Circle effective scope MUST decode to a complete RFC 9420 PublicMessage whose sender class is an active row of sender_classes[]. A structurally valid message whose sender class row is status=unsupported MUST be rejected with that row's rejection_error; it MUST NOT be reported as schema_violation, unsupported_event_kind, capability_denied or signature_invalid.

schema_violation stays reserved for structural failures: a missing, mistyped or unregistered field of schemas/event-payload.schema.json#/$defs/mls_proposal_payload, proposal_bytes_b64 that does not decode, a proposal_digest that does not equal the decoded bytes, a decoded group id or base epoch that does not equal the payload, and a wire format other than PublicMessage.

Admission evaluates in a fixed order so the reported code is deterministic: payload schema, then decode and digest and group and base epoch, then wire format, then the sender class row, then the decoded Proposal type row, then equality between the decoded Proposal type and the declared proposal_type token, then the member producer binding. An unsupported sender class or Proposal type is therefore reported before any declared-token mismatch it necessarily causes.

The active member row binds authorization, not only framing: the sender leaf MUST be occupied in the exact accepted base group state selected by payload.base_epoch and governance_binding.previous_epoch, and its LeafNode BasicCredential identity and signature key MUST equal the verified Event producer executed_by ?? actor_id under the closed regime of zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 2.7. A member sender that fails those bindings is not an unsupported feature: it is rejected as failed_precondition when the leaf is absent from the exact base and as signature_invalid when the credential or signature key does not equal the verified producer.

proposal_types[] rows with status=active keep every admission rule they already have; this registry never withdraws a standard member Proposal type. Rows with status=unsupported have no admissible v1 form and MUST fail closed with their rejection_error.

app_custom is admissible only when the decoded Proposal codepoint has an active row in application_proposal_types[] and the receiver implements that row's declared application semantics. application_proposal_types[] is empty in v1, so every app_custom Proposal MUST be rejected with unsupported_feature. An implementation MUST NOT treat an unrecognized codepoint as an authorized AppCustom Proposal and MUST NOT infer semantics from the private-use range alone.

Adding an application_proposal_types[] row requires the codepoint, its owning application semantics, the admission conditions and an active vector-registry.json row in the same registry release; registry activation alone never authorizes wire use.
Sidecar effective scopes keep their own handshake profile; this registry describes Realm and Circle durable Proposals only.

private_use_range.reference: IANA MLS Proposal Types registry, private-use range (RFC 9420)

sender_classes.producer_binding: sender.leaf_index MUST name a leaf occupied in the exact accepted base group state, and that LeafNode BasicCredential identity plus signature key MUST equal the verified Event producer executed_by ?? actor_id
sender_classes.description: The only v1 Proposal producer class for a Realm or Circle durable ak.mls.proposal.

RFC 9420 ExternalSender Proposal signed by a key listed in the GroupContext external_senders extension. v1 defines no binding from an external_senders index to a complete producer Actor, its current authorization or its freshness, so the class has no admissible form; the external_senders GroupContext extension itself is registered unsupported in mls-extension-registry.json.

RFC 9420 NewMemberProposal sender, used by a joiner to propose its own Add before it holds a leaf. v1 admits members only through an authorized Add that an existing member proposes and an authorized member commits.

RFC 9420 NewMemberCommit sender, used by external commits and external joins. zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6 already forbids external join and adding members by external Commit; this row pins the wire-level decision and the exact error for a Proposal or Commit that still carries the class.

proposal_types.description: Admits one exact target membership incarnation; target_actor_id and target_authorization_incarnation stay required and the consuming winning Commit defines that incarnation's join_epoch.
Replaces the sending member's own LeafNode; the replacement leaf stays bound to the same verified producer.
Removes an occupied leaf under the sending member's current accepted authority.
Injects a pre-shared key into the next epoch key schedule.
Reinitializes the group under the same scope-derived group identity; it never creates a second active group for an ordinary scope.

RFC 9420 ExternalInit, the Proposal type an external Commit uses to join a group. It has no mls_proposal_payload.proposal_type token because v1 has no external join; a decoded ExternalInit is reported before the declared-token mismatch it necessarily causes.

Replaces GroupContext extensions; the staged extension set MUST stay inside the active rows of mls-extension-registry.json and MUST satisfy the capability floor rules of encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.

Application-defined Proposal carried on a private-use codepoint. It becomes admissible only through an active application_proposal_types[] row, which v1 does not have; the payload keeps the app_custom token so a structurally valid but unsupported Proposal is reported as unsupported_feature rather than schema_violation.
